page: Microsoft Azure FX32-8mds_v2 is an x86_64 architecture server belonging to the FXmdsv2 family, designed specifically for memory-intensive workloads. It features a dedicated Intel Xeon 8573C processor with 4 physical cores and 8 vCPUs, operating at a high base clock speed of 4.2 GHz. The processor includes a substantial 260 MB L3 cache and supports advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 and Intel AMX (Advanced Matrix Extensions) for accelerated vector and matrix operations.

The standout characteristic of this server is its massive memory capacity of 672.0 GB, yielding an exceptionally high ratio of 84.0 GB of RAM per CPU core. This memory configuration is paired with 1890 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, and the instance is premium storage capable. No GPUs are included in this configuration.

In benchmark testing, the FX32-8mds_v2 exhibits strong single-core performance, achieving a Geekbench single-core score of 2352.0 and a text processing score of 2945.0, both placing in the top tier (top 10%). Single-threaded gzip compression (34.73 GB/sec) and bzip3 decompression (14.39 GB/sec) also perform in the top 25%. However, multi-core and memory bandwidth metrics generally fall into the average range, with stress-ng multi-core scoring 8876.24 and uncached large-block memory read bandwidth reaching 71.78 GB/sec. Large-model LLM inference is a notable bottleneck, with text generation on a 7B model and prompt processing on a 70B model registering in the bottom 25%.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the FX32-8mds_v2 offers an extremely high resource density of memory relative to compute cores, making it highly efficient for workloads that require massive RAM footprints but do not scale linearly with high vCPU counts. This makes the server highly suitable for large in-memory databases, heavy caching layers, enterprise relational database management systems (RDBMS), and memory-bound data processing tasks.
description: The Microsoft Azure FX32-8mds_v2 is a memory-intensive x86_64 server powered by a dedicated 4.2 GHz Intel Xeon 8573C processor with 4 physical cores and 8 vCPUs. It features an exceptionally high memory-to-core ratio, providing 672.0 GB of RAM alongside 1890 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. In benchmark evaluations, the server demonstrates top-tier single-core performance, highlighted by a Geekbench single-core score of 2352.0 and strong single-threaded compression speeds. However, multi-core scaling and large-model LLM inference speeds are more modest, aligning with average and weak performance tiers respectively. Given its massive memory footprint and high clock-speed processor, the FX32-8mds_v2 is highly optimized for large in-memory databases, memory-bound enterprise applications, and caching layers that require substantial RAM without requiring a high count of virtual processors.
